title: One Day Something (Terrible) is Going to Happen
original_title: Jednog dana dogodit će se nešto strašno
overview: Maša, beset by anxious reality in which she takes care of her ill mother, flees into the world of imagination, trying to create her own fairy tale. A phone call informs her of the death of a man she doesn't even know and she, without too much hesitation, decides to attend his funeral.
